entries.dd2ff19d135da9e5: It is a specialist manufacturer of hydraulic equipment headquartered in Ayase, Kanagawa Prefecture. The company, together with 12 consolidated subsidiaries, five non-consolidated subsidiaries and four affiliates, makes up a group of 22 companies in total, and its main businesses are the manufacture and sale of hydraulic products, system products and environmental machinery. Consolidated headcount for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,401, and the company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
